postings.title: Account Executive, Sweden
postings.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
Anaplan is seeking an ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE in Sweden, to drive its growth and expand its presence in the Nordics area.

In this role, you will take your proven track record of selling sophisticated technology solutions and account management and sell an incredibly versatile platform. Our sales team is helping industry leaders understand the impact of Anaplan products and how our connected planning solution is ending siloed decision-making. You will help our customers achieve their immediate business goals while setting their business up for the future.

This role will be a catalyst to Anaplan’s continued growth while leading digital transformation. Reporting directly to the RVP of Sales. You will have mostly greenfield accounts. This type of territory requires someone to further build our footprint by hunting and locking in new logo accounts as well as rapidly growing opportunities within the current customer base.

Your Impact

- Engaging with targeted prospects to identify broken business processes and position Anaplan’s unique ability to solve the problem,

- Build Anaplan’s business value throughout the selling engagement. Navigating sophisticated prospect environments to align the prospect around the Anaplan solution,

- Conduct highly effective presentations from Director through SVP and key C-suite level decision makers including CFOs, CROs, and senior leaders in supply chain, workforce, and other business functions,

- Develop customers and own opportunity management start-to-finish across multiple customer targets and functions,

- Apply Anaplan’s value-based selling methodology and tools to run sales processes and accurately forecast business,

- Employ outstanding account leadership skills to identify account expansion opportunities by cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within targeted accounts,

- Perform strategic sales planning, leading to accurate forecasting of the business,

- Work with cross-functional members of Sales Development Reps, Marketing, Solution Consultants, and the Customer Success teams.

Your Qualifications

- Extensive experience in consultative sales to Fortune 2000 companies, ideally in SaaS solutions (but not required)

- 'Hunter' with a strong growth mindset, motivated by developing new business essential

- Experience in Industrial verticals, Retail, Energy, Manufacturing and Business preferred

- Shown success selling into Vice President / Senior Vice President buyers,

- Track record of overachieving sales quota & targets, including demonstrated history of multiple high six-figure annual contract value (ACV) deals (services and/or software),

- Demonstrated network in your industry territory, with a mix of some customers and implementation partners,

- Demonstrated experience with sophisticated partner & internal team organizations,

- Domain understanding (Supply Chain, FP&A, Workforce Planning & Sales) and knowledge of how these functions plan, process work and make decisions,

- Strong, demonstrated opportunity management practices (e.g. sales process, qualification, executive presentation skills, quote presentation and negotiation), and ability to balance multiple (3-5) opportunities at once,

- Business, Finance, Economics, related BS/BA degree or relevant years of experience.

- Fluency in English and Swedish

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Outreach, SFDC, LinkedIn Sales Navigator a plus,

- Account Planning experience Altify, MEDDPICC, Miller Heiman.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) 

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

- Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   

- Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

Job Description: Data Integration Principal
Role Overview
As the Data Integration Principal, you will serve as a technical advisor for enterprise customers, partners, and internal Customer Success teams. Your mission is to architect scalable, repeatable data integration solutions across the Anaplan ecosystem while driving best practices, technical enablement, and product evolution.
Key Responsibilities

- Provide data integrations expertise for customers, partners, and customer success teams for successful customer deployments using repeatable solutions.

- Build competence by developing methodology, best practices, blogs, demos, webinars, training, and enablement on data integrations.

- Design not only an Anaplan solution, but take into account the wider technology solution and ecosystem for integrating data from various applications.

- Educate and advise customers and partners on data integration options and best practices.

- Interacting with the product organization to provide strategic guidance, share field insights, and actively shape the future direction of the integration product portfolio.

- Be proactive in learning new technologies for both internal and external applications.

- Maintain knowledge of adjunct technologies that support the Anaplan ecosystem including Informatica, Mulesoft, Boomi, SnapLogic.

- Author and share data integration best practices on a continual basis.

- Take complex issues and break them down into simple, manageable steps and milestones.

- Enable the broader talent ecosystem, both internal and external to Anaplan.

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of hands-on Anaplan experience, with a deep understanding of Anaplan platform architecture (Classic and Polaris engines) and data hub design.

- Deep expertise in Anaplan Transactional and Bulk APIs, Anaplan Connect, and native CloudWorks integrations.

- Experience advising IT teams on Integration Best Practices.

- Experience with cloud providers like AWS, GCP, and Azure.

- Experience with 3rd party connectors like Amazon S3, Databricks, SAP, Oracle, SFTP, Snowflake.

- Experience with programming and scripting skills (e.g., Python, Java Script, PowerShell, or Bash) for automated workflow development.

- Experience with AI products

Deep familiarity with modern API structures and protocols, specifically REST, SOAP, OAuth 2.0, and CA Certificate authentication.

postings.description:

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
About the Role

As Manager of Data Operations, you will lead the day-to-day execution of Anaplan’s revenue data programs and support the health of our Go-To-Market (GTM) data ecosystem. You will manage a team of data operations specialists, partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and GTM Operations, and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data across our GTM systems. This position reports to the Director of GTM Technology & Data Operations and plays an important cross-functional role in maintaining data quality standards and driving operational improvements. As this role supports global projects across AMER, EMEA, and APAC, the successful candidate will be required to work flexible hours to accommodate different time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Data Strategy & Governance

- Contribute to and execute against the data stewardship roadmap, supporting data ownership practices across GTM systems in alignment with direction from senior leadership.

- Partner with stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, and IT to understand priorities and translate them into actionable data operations work.

- Participate in cross-functional initiatives including territory planning, system migrations, and product launches, serving as the data operations point of contact.

- Maintain and improve comprehensive documentation for data processes, governance standards, and system workflows.

- Uphold data quality standards across GTM systems and work with cross-functional partners to address gaps and drive accountability.

Data Quality & Enrichment

- Manage the execution of data enrichment programs, leveraging tools such as ZoomInfo RingLead and D&B Connect to improve the completeness and depth of the GTM database. Coordinate with Marketing Operations.

- Support the definition and monitoring of data quality SLAs in partnership with Sales, Marketing, and GTM Ops, tracking outcomes and escalating issues as needed.

- Foster a proactive data quality culture through regular audits, cleansing routines, and ongoing stakeholder communication.

- Participate in the enterprise data governance framework as a GTM data representative, helping to implement policy and maintain compliance standards alongside the global Data Governance team.

Data Operations Execution

- Manage and continuously improve automation workflows for data management, including de-duplication, validation, and process automation in Salesforce and connected systems.

- Execute data-driven database hygiene campaigns to maintain database integrity, reduce sales friction, and improve marketing segmentation effectiveness.

- Prepare and share data quality reporting and operational status updates for stakeholders at the manager and director level.

- Support the evaluation of data tooling and assist in managing vendor relationships; provide input on tool performance and usage.

- Contribute to the data operations technology roadmap by identifying operational gaps and recommending solutions in partnership with leadership.

- Identify opportunities for AI-assisted data operations using tools such as Gemini Enterprise, implementing automations that reduce manual effort and improve data quality.

- Assist with tracking data operations spend and surface efficiency opportunities to leadership.

Team Leadership

- Manage, mentor, and develop a team of data operations professionals; foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture.

- Support team members' professional growth through regular coaching, feedback, and performance conversations.

- Coordinate team workload, set clear priorities, and ensure the team delivers against commitments on time and at quality.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.

- 5+ years of experience in data operations, data management, or business operations in a SaaS or technology company.

- 2+ years of direct people management experience, with demonstrated success leading a data operations team or function.

- Experience working cross-functionally and building productive relationships with peers in Sales, Marketing, and Operations.

- Comfortable presenting data quality metrics and operational updates to manager- and director-level stakeholders.

Technical Skills

- Core Data & CRM: Salesforce (Expert); SQL (proficient in querying, validation, and analysis)

- Data Integration & Warehousing: Informatica; Reverse ETL tools; Google BigQuery

- BI & Reporting: Tableau

- Data Enrichment & AI: ZoomInfo RingLead; D&B Connect; Gemini Enterprise

- GTM System Architecture: Familiarity with data flows for Marketing Automation Platforms (e.g., Marketo) and Sales Engagement Platforms (e.g., Outreach)

- Scripting (Preferred): Python or similar scripting language for data automation and API integration

- Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, power queries, pivot tables)

Core Competencies

- Operational Excellence: Proven ability to manage and improve data operations processes with measurable outcomes; comfortable working within established frameworks and escalating when needed.

- Process Improvement: Experience implementing or refining processes around data stewardship, integrity, deduplication, and validation.

- Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot database issues and translate data findings into clear, actionable business insights.

- Cross-Functional Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate with peers, align stakeholders, and convey data topics clearly to non-technical audiences.

- Vendor Coordination: Experience supporting vendor relationships and tracking tool performance and contract details.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
Your Impact 

We are looking for an Atlassian Administrator to help look after, shape and grow our company-wide Atlassian tools, including Jira, Confluence, Jira Align and Jira Service Management. You will work alongside our Senior Atlassian Administrator and partner with Product, Engineering, Technology and business teams to keep these tools reliable, simple to use and ready for the way we work. 

This is a great step for someone who already knows the basics of Atlassian administration and wants to grow into a broader, enterprise-level role. You will learn hands-on from experienced colleagues and take on more ownership as you go, across configuration, automation, integrations, governance and helping people get the most out of the tools. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Support the day-to-day running of Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management and related Atlassian tools, and troubleshoot issues people report with clear, practical fixes. 

- Set up and maintain Jira projects, issue types, workflows, screens, fields, permissions and notifications. 

- Look after Confluence spaces, permissions, templates and content standards. 

- Manage user access, groups and permissions, and keep access well governed. 

- Build and maintain Jira automation rules that cut down manual work. 

- Help design workflows and setups that support Product, Engineering, Agile and business processes, and review configuration requests to recommend options that meet business needs while keeping the platform simple to maintain. 

- Support connections between Atlassian tools and other company platforms. 

- Test and check configuration changes before they go live. 

- Support the setup and configuration of Jira Align, including teams, workstreams, hierarchies, boards and its connection with Jira. 

- Investigate and fix sync and data accuracy issues between Jira and Jira Align, so our planning structures link strategic goals to the work teams are delivering. 

- Help keep standards and good practice in place for Jira and Confluence and take part in governance and change-management activities. 

- Spot chances to simplify workflows, custom fields, permissions and other settings, and support regular reviews of projects, spaces, permissions and unused items. 

- Document admin procedures, standards and troubleshooting steps, and create guides, knowledge articles and training material that help people adopt the tools. 

- Be a friendly point of contact for Atlassian questions, work with Product Managers, Program Managers, Engineers and Scrum Masters to understand what they need, and share good practice for Jira, Confluence, Jira Align and agile tools. 

- Use approved AI tools, such as Rovo and Claude, to summarise requests and audit findings, spot repeat tasks that can become automations or self-service options, and find duplicate fields, unused workflows and stale spaces, always with human review and sensitive information protected. 

Your Qualifications 

- 2-5 years of experience administering or supporting Jira, Confluence or other Atlassian tools. 

- Working knowledge of Jira projects, workflows, issue types, screens, custom fields, permissions and notifications. 

- Familiarity with Jira Query Language (JQL). 

- Experience troubleshooting application and configuration issues. 

- A solid understanding of agile approaches (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and enterprise agile planning. 

- Experience with user provisioning, group management and access governance. 

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to turn business needs into platform solutions. 

- Clear written and spoken communication, and an easy way of working with both technical and non-technical colleagues. 

- A real interest in building deeper expertise across the Atlassian ecosystem. 

Nice to have 

- Jira Align experience, including Jira Software (Cloud) integration, portfolio and project hierarchy, quarterly planning and reporting. 

- Jira Service Management, Atlassian Automation or Confluence administration. 

- Atlassian Cloud and enterprise SaaS administration. 

- REST APIs and integrations, plus basic scripting or JSON. 

- Marketplace apps such as ScriptRunner or JMWE.

- Proficiency in Salesforce (or comparable CRM) for opportunity management and pipeline data maintenance.

Summary of Role

We are seeking an experienced Cloud Deal Desk leader to run our AMER Deal Desk. This is a player-coach role: the Director personally handles a significant share of the region's most strategic deals, working with the field to design value-based offers for many of Anaplan's largest customers, while also leading and developing the AMER team, serving as the trusted Deal Desk partner to GTM AMER leadership and Finance, and owning cross-functional projects that improve how we quote, contract, and close.

The Director carries out the core responsibilities of the Strategic Deal Manager role day to day, and sets the standard for the Strategic Deal Managers and Senior Analysts on the team. They exercise independent judgment, navigate ambiguity, and give Sales leaders clear, well-reasoned recommendations. When a deal hits an obstacle, they partner with the field and business partners to find a workable resolution that serves the customer and protects Anaplan. They actively participate in sales forecasting and deal reviews, and work closely with Sales, Product COEs, Finance, Legal, Revenue Recognition, and the global Deal Desk team.

Responsibilities

1. Strategic Deal Execution

Aligned to the Strategic Deal Manager role.

- Provide expert guidance to the Sales field and Sales Leadership on deal structuring, pricing, and contract management for the largest and most complex AMER opportunities

- Design value-based offers with the field; work with Product COEs to structure offers that include Anaplan's latest and most innovative offerings, unlocking value for the customer and driving adoption

- Participate in deal reviews with Sales and Sales Leadership to help drive account-level strategy on pricing and deal structure

- Review, interpret, and confirm contract terms and conditions; work closely with Finance and Legal to ensure contracts are accurate and compliant with internal policies and external regulations

- Draft, redline, and finalize contracts, including new business, add-ons, and renewals for Cloud Subscription Services

- Lead the Deal Desk approach to cloud marketplace deals in AMER, including private offers sold through the major cloud provider marketplaces

- Guide Sales and Alliances on structuring marketplace deals, including pricing, term alignment, and contracting through marketplace paper

- Hold deal approval authority in line with Anaplan's official approval guidelines, reviewing and approving deals for customers and prospects, and acting as the final regional escalation point for structure, pricing, and non-standard terms

- Process deals in Salesforce and CPQ, ensuring they are structured and processed efficiently and align to company policy

- Identify commercial, legal, financial, and revenue recognition risks early; anticipate issues and act to resolve them using professional judgment, company policy, and procedure

- Partner with Finance and Revenue Recognition to confirm pricing accuracy and rev rec treatment

- Participate actively in sales forecasting activities and end-of-quarter execution with deal status, risk analysis, and clear communication

2. Team Leadership

- Lead, coach, and develop the AMER Deal Desk team of 6, covering all of AMER and part of a global Deal Desk team of 19, including Strategic Deal Managers and Senior Analysts

- Set priorities, manage workload and coverage, especially through quarter-end peaks

- Run performance management, goal setting, feedback, and career development, including promotion cases and succession planning

- Hire, onboard, and train new team members

- Raise the team's skills in deal structuring, contract judgment, and stakeholder communication, and close any skills gaps between deal management levels

- Build a culture of ownership, quality, customer-first thinking, and continuous improvement

3. Programs, Process Improvement, and Enablement

- Own and/or participate in cross-functional projects and process improvements across Commercial Operations and Finance processes, extending beyond AMER where needed, from scoping through rollout and adoption

- Lead functional projects and process improvements for quoting and contracting, including CPQ and contract lifecycle management (CLM) workflows, configuration, and automation, working with the relevant business and systems teams

- Act as a delegate for select global projects, including CPQ implementation, taking ownership of workstreams or whole projects when assigned by Deal Desk and Commercial Operations leadership

- Independently drive efficiency and process improvements; support commercial projects as requested by the VP, Commercial Ops and/or the Global Head of Deal Desk, including UAT and new process documentation

- Drive documentation, playbooks, and standard work so the team and field operate consistently

- Support field enablement on policy changes, pricing and packaging updates, and new SKUs, working with the Pricing and Product teams

- Use deal and cycle-time data to identify bottlenecks and measure improvement

- Collaborate with the global Deal Desk team to align AMER practices with global standards and contribute regional input into global programs

4. Sales Leadership and Finance Partnership

- Serve as the primary Deal Desk contact and trusted business partner for GTM AMER leadership and Finance, attending regional leadership forums, forecast calls, and pipeline reviews as the Deal Desk voice

- Anticipate demand and flag trends in deal patterns, discounting, and non-standard requests; advise on how to structure the business for faster, cleaner closes, and maintain clear escalation paths so the field knows when and how to engage Deal Desk

- Partner with Sales to find solutions that close deals while protecting margin, compliance, and revenue quality, building Anaplan's corporate goals into the design of commercial offers

5. Governance and Compliance

- Own AMER adherence to deal approval, pricing, contracting, and revenue recognition policies

- Ensure deal documentation is accurate, auditable, and complete

- Partner with Legal and Finance on policy exceptions, contract templates, and regulatory or customer-driven requirements

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Anaplan's products, pricing models, and go-to-market strategy

Profile of the Ideal Candidate

Experience and Skills

- 7+ years of professional Deal Desk experience within SaaS

- 3+ years of people management, ideally leading analysts or managers in a deal desk or commercial operations environment

- Proven track record handling complex, high-value enterprise SaaS deals, including non-standard terms and multi-year structures

- Excellent understanding of Deal Support topics: hybrid and consumption pricing, deal structuring, contracting, and order management, with familiarity with revenue recognition policies

- Deep understanding of commercial legal terms and conditions

- Outstanding business partnering skills, able to influence outcomes with the Sales field, Product COEs, GTM Legal, and Finance

- Strong oral and written communication and excellent documentation skills

- Strong proficiency with Salesforce (SFDC) and CPQ required, including configuring, reviewing, and processing deals end to end

- Conga experience a plus

- Proficiency with AI tools and agents, including Google Gemini, and comfort adopting AI-assisted workflows to improve quote construction, contract review, and team productivity

- Strong Excel, contract review, and business writing skills; FP&A experience a strong plus

Attributes

- Customer first: a customer-first perspective and ethos in how offers are designed

- Sound commercial judgment: weighs revenue, margin, risk, and customer outcome, and can defend a recommendation

- Credible with senior stakeholders: builds trust with Sales leaders and executives, and guides decisions with data and clear rationale

- Product-curious: learns Anaplan's products quickly and can articulate the value they deliver to customers

- Strong communicator: clear and concise across Zoom, Slack, email, and in leadership forums

- Builder and coach: develops people and raises the bar for the team

- Systematic thinker: spots recurring problems and fixes the process, not just the instance

- Organized and dependable: prioritizes well and meets deadlines under quarter-end pressure

- Collaborative: works as a peer with Finance, Legal, Rev Rec, Product COEs, and global Deal Desk counterparts

As a mid-senior individual contributor, you will be part of a collaborative team of five engineers reporting to the team engineering manager.

You will play a key role in delivering our environments strategy, shifting Anaplan away from shared development environments toward reproducible, automated local and ephemeral environments.

As well as this, you will take ownership of the health of our remaining shared non-production environments, maintain our Argo CD deployment architecture, oversee secrets management using Vault, and establish resilient, code-driven governance for feature flagging that delivers lasting value.

Your Impact...

- Empower engineering teams: Collaborate in a cross-functional team to build and operate tools, frameworks, and platforms that improve developer experience, platform scalability, and security for hundreds of engineers

- Shape the future of environments: Contribute to the design, implementation, and roll-out of our next-generation environments strategy, helping transition engineering teams to automated, code-defined local and remote ephemeral environments

- Champion environment health: Take collective ownership of our non-production environments, ensuring platform service health and acting as a trusted first port of call for engineering support and troubleshooting

- Scale deployment & configuration infrastructure: Contribute to the maintenance and architectural evolution of our Argo CD deployment pipelines, secrets management infrastructure, and feature flagging capabilities

- Evolve existing platform tooling: Help maintain, refactor, and modernize our existing Go-based tools, APIs, and Kubernetes Operators to eliminate configuration toil and support new platform capabilities by elevating standards

- Delivering measurable outcomes: Act as a proactive self-starter who takes end-to-end ownership of your work through agile practices, planning, and road mapping, while participating in the team on-call rota

- CD & GitOps: Strong practical understanding of continuous delivery pipelines, GitOps workflows, and continuous deployment tooling (specifically Argo CD)

- Platform-as-a-Product: A passion for treating platform infrastructure as a product, focusing on improving Developer Experience, reducing cognitive load for engineers, and gathering feedback to build highly usable tools

- Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools, ideally Terraform

- Secrets management: Experience working with HashiCorp Vault or similar secrets management technologies

- Resilience & quality mindset: A focus on building fault-tolerant systems, backed by automated testing, golden templates, and clear developer documentation

- Strong communication: A collaborative mindset with the ability to provide clear guidance, support, best practices and articulate trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences

- Software engineering: Hands-on development experience in Go (or a similar language)

- Kubernetes operators: Experience writing, testing, or maintaining Kubernetes Operators and Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs)

In this role, you will leverage your proven track record of selling sophisticated SaaS solutions to represent an incredibly versatile and powerful platform. We're looking for a competitor with a hunter mindset who loves to win. You will be a catalyst for our continued growth by leading digital transformation and helping industry leaders end siloed decision-making.

This role reports directly to the Regional Vice President (RVP) and manages a territory consisting of both greenfield opportunities and existing Anaplan customers. This requires a unique individual who can hunt for and secure new logos while also identifying and growing opportunities within our current customer base. You will embody our core values (Innovative, Accountable, Collaborative, Transparent, Resilient, Empathetic, Authentic, Learner) as you help customers achieve their immediate goals and prepare their business for the future.

- Engage with targeted consumer-focused organizations prospects to identify broken business processes and position Anaplan’s unique ability to solve the problem.

- Build and communicate Anaplan’s business value throughout the selling engagement, navigating complex prospect environments to align stakeholders around the Anaplan solution.

- Conduct highly effective, consultative presentations to key C-suite level decision-makers, including CFOs, CROs, and senior leaders across Supply Chain, Finance, and HR.

- Leverage modern AI tools and digital platforms to execute targeted, data-driven outbound sales campaigns and effectively position the business value of Anaplan’s AI-powered planning capabilities to prospective clients.

- Develop and own opportunity management from start to finish across multiple customer targets and functions.

- Apply Anaplan’s value-based selling methodology to manage a robust sales process and accurately forecast your business.

- Employ outstanding account leadership skills to identify expansion opportunities by cross-selling and up-selling within your targeted accounts.

- Collaborate effectively with a matrixed team of Sales Development Reps, Marketing professionals, Solution Consultants, and Customer Success partners to ensure customer success.

Your Qualifications

- Ideally 10-15 years of direct, consultative sales experience, with a consistent track record of overachieving quota in a competitive market.

- Extensive experience selling complex SaaS solutions (enterprise resource planning, supply chain management and/or human capital management) into Fortune 2000 companies.

- Strong AI literacy, including hands-on experience using AI technologies to optimize sales workflows and a proven ability to consultatively sell complex AI/predictive analytics software features.

- Proven success selling into multiple Lines of Business (LOBs) and navigating complex, multi-threaded buying centers.

- A demonstrated history of career stability.

- Mastery of outcome-based sales methodologies such as Challenger selling, TAS, MEDDPICC or Miller Heiman.

- Demonstrated experience selling into Consumer (e.g. FMCG, F&B, Apparel, Retailer) accounts.

- Demonstrated understanding of the pressing business challenges faced by consumer-facing enterprises today.

The Ideal Candidate

Japan is a strategic market for Anaplan Supply Chain, and this is a strategic hire. As our senior Supply Chain leader in Japan, and a key SCM voice across APAC, you will be the face of Anaplan SCM to the region’s largest manufacturers, retailers and CPG companies. You will win deals by shaping how executives think about connected planning, and change how the market perceives Anaplan SCM, starting in Japan and extending across APAC. You will also bring the region’s needs to our global product teams and influence the SCM roadmap. 

This is not an advisory or support role. You will step in front of Account Executives, lead the supply chain conversation from first meeting to close, and be accountable for the SCM pipeline and revenue you influence.

Drive SCM revenue 

- Own SCM pipeline creation and deal progression in Japan. Proactively lead executive and senior practitioner conversations alongside Sales, rather than waiting to be pulled in. 

- Carry the SCM number for the Japan and APAC segment across both Applications and the broader SCM portfolio, owning pipeline, bookings and forecast accuracy with regional leadership. 

- Build joint account plans with AEs and Customer Success for priority manufacturing, retail and CPG accounts, and turn customer pain points into compelling business cases. 

- Lead discovery, solution storyline, demos, workshops and proofs of value across S&OP/IBP, demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimization, network design and procurement.

- Partner with SCM and GTM leaders in India, ANZ and Southeast Asia to build a consistent regional SCM pipeline strategy, prioritize high-value accounts, and bring Japan’s playbooks to other APAC markets. 

- Provide hands-on support for strategic APAC pursuits where deep SCM expertise is needed, and coordinate with in-country SCM leads so the right SME covers each deal. 

- Drive expansion by acting as a trusted advisor to customers after the sale. 

Shift the perception of Anaplan SCM 

- Be the visible thought leader for Anaplan SCM in Japan, speaking at customer events, analyst briefings, industry forums and executive roundtables. 

- Create Japanese-language content, including POVs, use cases, ROI stories and customer references. Build a repeatable SCM story that moves Japanese enterprises from spreadsheets and legacy planning tools to connected, scenario-based planning. 

- Establish Japan as the reference market for Anaplan SCM in APAC by building customer references and stories that can be used regionally. 

- Represent Anaplan SCM at regional analyst briefings, industry events and customer forums. 

- Cultivate relationships with SIs, consultancies and ecosystem partners to build SCM delivery capacity and co-sell motions in Japan.

- Act as the voice of the customer for Japan to global SCM product management. Bring structured field feedback and requirements from Japanese manufacturers, retailers and CPG companies, and help shape roadmap priorities. 

- Consolidate requirements from Japan and the wider APAC region into a single, prioritized voice to global SCM product management. 

- Support application design, early-adopter programs and pre-market testing with Japanese customers.

- Build SCM sales plays, discovery frameworks, demo assets and evaluation guides for Sales, Solution Consulting, Partners and Customer Success in Japan. 

- Coach teams and partners so SCM selling becomes repeatable at scale and doesn’t depend on you alone. 

Success Measures 

- SCM pipeline generated and influenced, and bookings closed in Japan and APAC, with forecast accuracy (targets set with leadership) 

- Win rate and competitive displacement in SCM deals 

- Number of strategic accounts with active SCM engagement and expansion plays 

- Number of APAC accounts engaged through reusable Japan-led SCM plays and references 

- Growth in market visibility: executive events, analyst engagement, customer references, partner-led opportunities 

- Adoption of SCM enablement by Sales and partners, and feedback from GTM teams 

- Impact on the global SCM roadmap through documented Japan and APAC requirements

- Deep, hands-on SCM expertise (typically 15+ years, ideally 20+) across end-to-end planning: demand, supply, S&OP/IBP, inventory, procurement and network planning. - Credibility with Japanese enterprise supply chain executives. You can be the respected SME in the room with a COO, CSCO or Head of SCM. 

- Business-level or higher proficiency in Japanese and English. 

- Proven record in consultative or strategic selling, preferably in enterprise software. You have actively led deals, taken pipeline ownership and stepped in front of AEs. 

- Working knowledge of competing planning platforms such as o9, Kinaxis, SAP IBP and Blue Yonder, and ideally of Anaplan.

This role is responsible for driving Anaplan's Public Sector partner sales strategy in conjunction with: 

- North America Alliance Directors: who manage our largest and most strategic partner relationships through detailed business planning and go-to-market development to drive sourced and co-sold revenue 

- Partner & Alliance Teams: to drive target agency and account planning, sales play development, new routes to market (including contract vehicles and reseller channels), effective Anaplan field engagement, pipeline progression, and delivery readiness 

- Anaplan Sales: responsible for Public Sector go-to-market across Federal, State & Local, and Education, and for client-specific sales motions that bring mission-relevant solutions to market and identify partner-originated and co-sell opportunities to influence agency and institution buying cycles 

- Customer Success: responsible for customer retention and expansion, ensuring partners drive post-sale platform adoption, roadmap development, and measurable mission and value outcomes 

- Marketing: responsible for extending the Anaplan message to public sector audiences and driving pipeline generation in support of solution plays 

This role requires a deep understanding of the Anaplan partner ecosystem as it serves the public sector, including federal and public sector-focused system integrators, strategic advisory firms, value-added resellers and distributors that hold contract vehicles, cloud service providers (including government cloud regions), technology ISVs, and boutique consultancies at the field level (by segment, agency, and function). 

Understanding the complexities and functional value drivers of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) in a government context, such as budget formulation and execution, grants and program funding, workforce planning, and cost transparency, along with knowledge of Anaplan's public sector addressable market, procurement dynamics, and go-to-market approach, is highly preferred. 

The role is a direct report to the Senior Director, Partner Sales for the Americas, with dual accountability to the Public Sector Area Vice Presidents of Sales for the Americas. 

Your Impact

Primarily, you will be responsible for authoring and delivering originated/sourced revenue, co-sold revenue, and pipeline creation to meet or exceed Americas Public Sector sales goals through the development of a detailed Public Sector partner strategy and business plan, in coordination with Americas alliance managers. 

You will contribute to the development and evangelism of the Americas Partners & Alliances strategy as it supports Anaplan's overall growth goals, striving to build a best-in-class partner program within SaaS. 

You will manage policies and plans to avoid conflict with partners who participate in direct and indirect channels, including partners selling through government contract vehicles. This includes communicating clear rules of engagement and driving pipeline governance with internal teams and partners. In strategy development, you will help illuminate new public sector market opportunities, ensure a high-impact solution play portfolio aligned to agency and institutional priorities, and ensure partner collaboration from pre-sale through post-sale cycles, including compliance, security, and procurement readiness. 

You will also work with Anaplan field sales to identify potential new partnership opportunities within Public Sector to augment our global partner organization, including partners with established agency relationships, cleared resources, or access to key contract vehicles. 

Execution & Alignment with Sales NNACV and Pipeline Goals 

Success is tied directly to the Public Sector Area Vice Presidents of Sales for the Americas' goals via the contribution of primarily sourced ACV as well as co-sold ACV by Anaplan partners, while also ensuring delivery readiness. 

- Builds a comprehensive, electronic network/relationship map of Anaplan partner leaders in the Public Sector segment, including integrators, resellers, CSPs, and ISVs, continuously adding new relationships and curating existing ones to influence greater Anaplan sales development. 

- Creates awareness of partners' capabilities with Anaplan's sales teams by developing marketing, enablement, and go-to-market programs in conjunction with Partner Alliance Directors, increasing awareness and fair representation of partners serving Federal, SLED, and Education. Helps identify and drive solution offerings that provide value to Anaplan in key public sector vertical and horizontal solution areas. 

- Responsible for the day-to-day, field-level relationship and pipeline management of channel partners at the Public Sector sales pod level. Within each pod, field team members regularly evaluate the partner talent ecosystem and provide insights to global partner leadership on where existing partners are succeeding and where they lack sufficient sales, pre-sales, model-builder, solution architect, or cleared-resource talent to support the needs of the pod in both direct and indirect models. 

- Facilitates and extends relationships for the Public Sector Area Vice Presidents and other Americas leadership with thought leaders and change agents at impactful partners. 

- Manages and monitors compliance and hygiene of all sales processes, ensuring accurate data (e.g., pipeline, origination, co-sell, resell, cloud, contract vehicle) is correctly tagged with minimal attribution conflict. 

- Tracks public sector buying cycles, including fiscal year-end timing, budget and appropriations cycles, and procurement milestones, to time partner engagement and forecast pipeline accurately. 

Your Qualifications 

For this role we are looking for: 

- Experience in Cloud and SaaS software sales, consulting, customer support, and/or partner management. This is a must. 

- Experience selling to or through partners in the public sector (Federal, SLED, and/or Education), including familiarity with contract vehicles, resellers, and public procurement processes, is strongly preferred. 

- You are a strategic problem solver but execution oriented. This role is a catalyst for leading change in our overall go-to-market strategy with partners. 

- You possess public sector industry knowledge and the gravitas to collaborate with both global and federal-focused system integrator partners and C-suite leaders at boutique partner organizations. 

- You can prioritize an intense workload while identifying the opportunities that will drive the biggest return on investment. 

- You have a track record in sales and go-to-market execution and can articulate the results you have driven. 

- You are metrics-driven and able to measure, manage, and adjust to achieve your goals. 

- You can multitask across objectives, service lines, sales reps, leadership, partners, marketing, and product functions. 

- We would like to see evidence of how you have established trusted, deep relationships with key stakeholders on all sides of the partnership landscape. 

- Demonstrable experience in Business Development, including alliance establishment, alliance management, and marketing. 

- Experience identifying market opportunities with a track record of instigating go-to-market plans and subsequent sales follow-through. 

- Commercially astute, with the ability to promote the Anaplan proposition conceptually by illustrating business benefits and mission outcomes. 

- Working knowledge of public sector compliance and security considerations (e.g., FedRAMP, StateRAMP, data residency) and how they shape partner and solution strategy. 

- Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences and present the business value of the proposition. 

- A good communicator and presenter with strong negotiation skills and sound interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence all levels of an organization.

You build for high concurrency, low latency, and eventual consistency.

- Systems Programming: Advanced proficiency in Go, Rust, or JVM-based languages, with a focus on writing memory-efficient and thread-safe code.

- Storage Internals: We need more than S3 API knowledge. You should understand the performance characteristics, limitations, and cost-drivers of S3, NFS, and enterprise
storage like NetApp OnTap or AWS FSx.

- Data Locality: Experience managing data persistence across hybrid environments (Public Cloud vs. Private DC).

You believe that "if it isn't monitored, it doesn't exist."

- Instrumentation: Expert-level experience with OpenTelemetry. You don't just look at metrics; you design the telemetry that allows for deep-dive distributed tracing and root-cause analysis.

- Observability Infrastructure: Hands-on experience scaling Prometheus and Grafana to
handle high-cardinality data.

· Strong experience in Golang programming
· Proven experience in building and working with CRDs and Operators.
· Proven cloud experience using observability and operating workloads in Kubernetes.
· Experience with cloud storage S3, NFS, NetApp OnTap, AWS FSX

· Programming languages: GoLang, Java11, Kotlin, Rust, Python

Anaplan is looking for a curious, people-loving puzzle solver to join our Premium Support team, a small, tight-knit cohort inside Anaplan Support. Some of the world’s largest companies plan their entire business on Anaplan. When something goes sideways for our most invested customers, Premium is who they call.

Because the team is small, your work is visible and your ideas matter. You won’t be a ticket number in a giant queue. You’ll be a trusted investigator, translator, and builder, and you’ll help shape what Premium Support at Anaplan becomes next.

Your Impact

- Solve puzzles that matter. A model is behaving strangely. An integration failed overnight. Something is slow and nobody knows why. You’ll dig through logs and data (Grafana, Google BigQuery and more), form hypotheses, test them, and find the root cause.

- Talk to people, a lot. You’ll work with a portfolio of top-tier customers across global time zones by phone, chat, and email, join escalation calls, and see issues through end to end. Part of the craft is taking something complex and breaking it into simple, clear steps.

- Own what you design. As we build new premium services, you’ll help invent them. Spot a gap, design a process, tool, or playbook to close it, and own it from first sketch to rollout.

- Connect the dots across Anaplan. You’ll collaborate with Customer Care, Business Partners, Technical Product Managers, TechOps, Development, QA, and account teams, so customers stay successful and see real value from the platform.

- Teach what you learn. Write help and training content for the Anaplan Community, and mentor teammates so the whole team keeps getting sharper.

- Show up when it counts. Our customers run mission-critical work on Anaplan, so you’ll occasionally work outside regular business hours and juggle several customers at once.

Your Qualifications

We care far more about how your brain works than about a list of past job titles.

- You’re curious to the bone. You take things apart (literally or figuratively) to understand how they work, and “I don’t know yet” sounds like an invitation. The question, “but, why?” drives you.

- You love a good puzzle. Logic puzzles, escape rooms, strategy games, crosswords, a stubborn bug: you’d rather wrestle with it than look up the answer.

- Computers and computing are no stranger. While you may not know how to write Python scripts, concepts like distributed hosting, file storage systems, APIs, application logs are all familiar. If you like watching videos of Defcon speeches, that also counts. Already a Postman all-star? Perfect.

- Art and logic both light you up. You can appreciate the elegance of a well-structured spreadsheet and a well-composed song, and you see how creativity and rigor feed each other.

- You genuinely like people. You’ve done people-facing work of some kind, and it doesn’t have to be software support. Restaurants, retail, hospitality, tutoring, coaching, call centers, and front desks all count. If you’ve calmly turned around an unhappy table in the middle of a Friday dinner rush, you’ve already done a version of this job.

- You play with systems. We want evidence that you poke at existing tools, games, and systems to see what they can do. Maybe you modded a game, built an absurdly detailed spreadsheet, automated your home, wrote a macro to skip a boring task, min-maxed a build, or reverse-engineered a board game’s economy. Tell us about it.

- You’re comfortable with spreadsheets and data. Advanced Excel skills, plus a basic understanding of how data moves between systems (imports, exports, integrations), or the drive to get there fast.

- You thrive in motion. You’re a self-starter who’s happy in a loosely structured, fast-moving environment, and a collaborator who believes the team wins together. Sometimes you’ll be the person on call when a Fortune 500 company hits the panic button.

Nice to Have

None of these are dealbreakers. We can teach tools; we can’t teach curiosity.

- Experience with SaaS / software support, performance testing. QA testing, or similar.

- A 4-year degree in a related field, or equivalent experience

- Anaplan Model Building certification (Level 1, 2, or 3)

- Experience with multi-dimensional modeling or analytics tools such as Anaplan, IBM Cognos, Hyperion, Business Objects, TM1, or SAP BPC

- Experience in supply chain, finance, workforce planning, sales forecasting, or business management

- Experience with ServiceNow, Salesforce, Jira, or Confluence

- Experience with Grafana, log files, or monitoring tools

Engineer V – AI Architecture | Agentic AI & Conversational AI

Location: Gurugram, India | Work Model: Hybrid | Level: Engineer V

About Anaplan

Anaplan is a leading enterprise planning and decision-making platform that enables organizations to connect strategy, planning and execution across finance, supply chain, workforce and other critical business functions. As enterprises increasingly move toward AI-powered decision-making, Anaplan is building the next generation of intelligent experiences that combine enterprise data, advanced analytics, Generative AI and automation.

We are looking for an exceptional Engineer V – AI Architecture to play a pivotal role in defining and building this future.

About the Role

The Engineer V – AI Architecture is a senior technical architecture role focused on the design and evolution of Anaplan’s next generation of Agentic AI and Conversational AI capabilities. The role sits at the intersection of AI, software architecture, distributed systems and enterprise product engineering and is intended for an architect who is equally comfortable discussing system architecture at a strategic level and getting hands-on with the technology when required.

You will define how intelligent agents interact with users, enterprise data, business applications, APIs and planning capabilities. You will architect systems that can understand natural-language intent, maintain context, reason over relevant information, retrieve enterprise knowledge, invoke tools, orchestrate multi-step workflows and deliver reliable outcomes.

This is not an architecture-only position. We are looking for someone who still enjoys engineering and is comfortable moving from architecture diagrams and technical strategy to prototypes, experiments and production-quality code. While architecture and technical leadership will be the primary focus, hands-on coding will be an important part of the role when required to validate architectural decisions, develop reference implementations, build critical capabilities or solve complex technical problems. Depending on business and project requirements, approximately 20–30% of the role may involve hands-on engineering and coding.

What You Will Work On

You will be responsible for shaping the technical architecture of AI-powered experiences across the Anaplan platform. This includes designing intelligent agent architectures capable of understanding business intent and context, determining the appropriate actions or information required, interacting with enterprise systems and executing workflows in a secure and controlled manner.

You will help evolve Anaplan from traditional conversational experiences toward sophisticated agentic systems that can reason, plan, retrieve information, use enterprise tools and collaborate across multiple services. You will establish architectural patterns for agent orchestration, state and memory management, tool and function calling, context management, retrieval, workflow execution and human-in-the-loop controls.

A significant part of the role will involve designing Conversational AI architecture that allows users to interact naturally with complex planning and decision-making capabilities. You will think deeply about multi-turn conversations, context preservation, intent understanding, response generation, grounding, explainability and the boundary between deterministic business logic and probabilistic AI.

You will also architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions that enable AI systems to work effectively with enterprise knowledge and data. This will require strong understanding of embeddings, semantic and hybrid retrieval, vector search, metadata, ranking, context construction, authorization-aware retrieval and techniques for improving grounding and reducing hallucinations.

You will evaluate and apply modern foundation models and AI technologies based on business requirements rather than simply adopting the latest technology. You will consider model capability, reasoning quality, latency, cost, context windows, reliability, structured outputs, tool calling and model routing, and determine where approaches such as prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, conventional software or agentic workflows are most appropriate.

Hands-on Engineering

Although the role is architecturally oriented, you will remain technically close to the implementation. You may write code in Python, Java, C#, Go or other relevant technologies to build prototypes, validate architecture, develop AI workflows, implement critical components or demonstrate technical feasibility.

You will be expected to understand implementation details deeply enough to challenge designs, identify technical risks and make informed architectural decisions. The strongest candidate will be someone who can move naturally between designing a distributed AI platform, reviewing an architecture document, experimenting with an LLM-based workflow and writing the code required to prove that the approach works.

You will work closely with engineering teams to ensure that architecture does not remain theoretical. You will help translate architectural concepts into scalable, maintainable and production-ready software and will remain engaged through implementation, performance optimization and operationalization.

Enterprise AI Architecture

The systems you design will need to operate within the realities of enterprise software. You will therefore consider scalability, availability, resilience, observability, security, privacy, governance, performance and cost as first-class architectural concerns.

You will design AI capabilities that integrate with microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, enterprise data platforms and cloud infrastructure. You will work across service boundaries and help establish patterns for asynchronous processing, orchestration, caching, fault tolerance, high availability and graceful failure.

You will also help establish the architectural foundations required to make AI systems measurable and trustworthy. This includes approaches for evaluating response quality, groundedness, hallucination, retrieval performance, agent success, tool selection, latency, token consumption and overall task completion.

Security and Responsible AI

Enterprise AI introduces unique security and governance challenges, and you will be expected to incorporate these considerations directly into the architecture. You will work with security and platform teams to address concerns such as data privacy, identity and authorization, secure retrieval, prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissions, tool access, auditability and protection of sensitive enterprise information.

The architecture should enable AI systems to be powerful without becoming uncontrolled. You will help establish appropriate guardrails, authorization boundaries, monitoring and human-approval mechanisms for agent-driven actions.

Technical Leadership

At Engineer V level, you will operate as a senior technical authority and architectural leader. You will influence engineering teams through strong technical judgment, design thinking and hands-on credibility.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, AI/ML, Data, Security, Platform and UX teams to translate complex business requirements into technically sound solutions. You will lead architecture discussions, drive important technical decisions, establish reusable design patterns and influence the long-term AI technology roadmap.

You will also mentor senior engineers and architects, raise engineering standards and help create a culture where AI solutions are designed with the same rigor expected of mission-critical enterprise software.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced software architect or senior engineer with 12+ years of experience designing and building sophisticated software systems, with substantial exposure to distributed systems, cloud architecture and modern AI technologies.

You should have meaningful hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models, Agentic AI, Conversational AI or closely related technologies, ideally having taken AI-powered solutions from experimentation or proof of concept through production.

Strong software engineering fundamentals are essential. You should be highly comfortable with at least one modern programming language and have substantial experience designing APIs, microservices, cloud-native applications and distributed systems.

You should have a deep understanding of modern LLM application architecture, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompting, context management, tool and function calling, agent orchestration and AI evaluation. Experience with technologies such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI Search, vector databases or comparable technologies would be valuable.

Experience with multi-agent systems, MCP, AI observability, LLM evaluation, enterprise knowledge systems and secure AI architectures would be particularly relevant.

Most importantly, you should be able to demonstrate that you understand the difference between building an AI demo and engineering an enterprise-grade AI system.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an architect who is deeply technical, commercially pragmatic and genuinely hands-on. You understand that successful AI architecture is not simply about selecting an LLM or implementing a chatbot. It requires thoughtful integration of models, data, software systems, business logic, security, infrastructure and user experience.

You are comfortable asking difficult architectural questions, challenging assumptions and making trade-offs between intelligence, reliability, latency, scalability and cost. You can communicate a complex architecture to senior leadership and then sit with engineers to work through the implementation details.

You are curious about emerging AI technologies but grounded in strong software engineering principles. You know when to use an agent and when a deterministic workflow is better. You understand where LLMs add value and where conventional software should remain in control.

Most importantly, you want to help build AI systems that move beyond simple conversational interfaces and become trusted, intelligent and deeply integrated into enterprise decision-making.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to shape the architecture of AI at one of the world's leading enterprise planning platforms. You will have the opportunity to work on problems at the intersection of Agentic AI, Generative AI, enterprise software, decision intelligence and large-scale distributed systems.

Your architecture will influence how users interact with Anaplan, how intelligent agents reason over enterprise information, how AI interacts with business processes and ultimately how organizations use AI to make better planning and business decisions.

If you are a Technical Architect who still loves to code, an AI engineer who thinks in systems, and a technology leader who wants to define what enterprise Agentic AI looks like at scale, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact at Anaplan.

Map detections to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and contribute to improving coverage, precision, and resilience against evasion.

- AI-Augmented Security Operations: Help explore and apply AI and machine learning to enhance security operations capabilities — including alert triage, incident response acceleration, threat intelligence analysis, threat hunting, and the enrichment and prioritisation of detection content. Contribute to evaluating emerging AI tooling and embedding it responsibly into team workflows.

Work with threat intelligence feeds and platforms to support a timely and structured flow of actionable intelligence into security operations.

- Threat Hunting: Take part in proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts across the environment to identify attacker activity that evades existing detections. Document and share findings in a structured way, using hunt outcomes to inform and improve detection engineering and tooling.

- Detection & Response Skills: Practical experience developing and tuning SIEM detections, writing threat hunting queries, and participating in incident response activities.

- Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting: Experience working with threat intelligence platforms and feeds, and integrating intelligence into security tooling, detection logic, and operational processes. - IGA Platform Administration: Be a key contributor to the day-to-day administration and ongoing development of Anaplan’s Identity Governance and Administration platform (currently SailPoint). This includes supporting the full identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver), configuring and maintaining application connectors, building and refining role models, and running access certification campaigns to ensure least-privilege access across the organisation.

- PAM Programme Build-Out: Play a key role in the evaluation, selection, and initial implementation of Anaplan’s Privileged Access Management capability. Help define requirements, assess tooling options, and work with cross-functional stakeholders to design and deploy a PAM solution covering privileged account discovery and vaulting, just-in-time (JIT) access, session monitoring, and credential rotation.

- Non-Human Identity (NHI) Lifecycle Management: Contribute to the development and implementation of governance frameworks for non-human identities across the enterprise, including service accounts, API keys, secrets, certificates, and OAuth tokens. - Identity Automation & Engineering: Build and maintain automation to streamline identity processes, including provisioning and de-provisioning workflows, access request fulfilment, and lifecycle rule development. Contribute scripts, integrations, and tooling that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy and consistency across identity operations.

- Access Governance & Compliance: Support access review and certification processes, SoD (Separation of Duties) policy definition and enforcement, and identity-related audit reporting. postings.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
About the Team 

Security Trust & Risk owns governance, risk, compliance, vendor & customer assurance and business continuity across Anaplan's ecosystem. This role is a genuine ground-floor opportunity. You'll help build the technical backbone that lets GRC operate as an engineering discipline, pivoting away from point in time audits and risk scores, into a continuously measured heartbeat, driving prioritization and high visibility and even higher impact decisions. 

Your Role 

As a Senior GRC Engineer based in the UK, you're the technical bridge between GRC and the rest of the business, with a natural focus on UK/EU regulatory and market-access requirements. You're comfortable sitting in a room with engineering and talking architecture on some days, and on other days, feeling confident on a call with a customer and translating security in practice to build trust. Your north star is compliance by design: instead of audits being a point-in-time scramble to assemble evidence, they should be a natural byproduct of controls, monitoring, and processes that run continuously, year-round. 

A core part of that is thinking in terms of build once, apply to many: using our cross-framework control crosswalk to identify where requirements across our certified standards, including ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701, and 42001, SOC 1/2 Type 2, Cyber Essentials, ENS, and TX-RAMP genuinely overlap, so our partners build to a single common control instead of a different bespoke solution for every certification. Just as important as the automation itself is making the reasoning behind it visible: helping partners across the business understand the why behind a given control, whether it traces back to a compliance obligation, a customer request, or an emerging threat, not just the what. Over time, you'll develop genuine fluency in how the Anaplan product and platform actually work, how our infrastructure and internal systems are managed, and where our security controls live operationally. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Act as a technical GRC partner to technical and non-technical teams, translating compliance, governance, and risk requirements into implementation details, and engaging credibly in architecture/design discussions 

- Use the cross-framework control crosswalk to identify synergies across regulatory requirements, so engineers build one common solution instead of duplicating effort per certification 

- Support customer-facing security/compliance conversations requiring deeper technical context (platform architecture, control implementation, how obligations are met) 

- Build the processes, scripts, workflows, and tooling that embed controls into daily operations, and design automation that keeps compliance/risk data current continuously rather than refreshed only ahead of audits 

- Create knowledge-sharing resources and clear documentation/diagrams that help partners understand the reasoning behind a control - whether it's a compliance obligation, a customer request, or an emerging threat, not just the mechanics of it; bring particular depth on UK/EU frameworks and market-access requirements (e.g., Cyber Essentials, GDPR, ISO 27701) into the crosswalk 

- Partner with Risk Management to engineer risk identification, scoring, and monitoring into day-to-day operations; support continuous monitoring (ConMon) across Compliance, Risk, and Governance; and build working knowledge of the Anaplan product/platform over time 

About You 

You're as comfortable in a room full of engineers debating architecture as you are explaining to a customer how a specific control works under the hood. You don't just document controls - you build things: a script that automates an evidence pull, a workflow that keeps a risk register current, a diagram that makes an audit go faster because the auditor can actually see how the system works. You instinctively look for the one solution that covers several requirements at once, rather than building a separate one for each. You think about compliance as something that should run continuously in the background, not something the organization gears up for once a year. 

Qualifications 

- Extensive commercial experience in security engineering, GRC, DevSecOps, or a closely related technical role, with hands-on exposure to compliance/regulatory frameworks 

- Comfortable writing scripts or light code (Python, Bash, or similar) to automate evidence collection, reporting, or monitoring tasks 

- Working knowledge of at least two of: ISO 27001 and its extensions (27017, 27018, 27701, 42001), SOC 1/2, and familiarity with UK/EU-relevant frameworks (Cyber Essentials, UK GDPR, ISO 27701, etc.), including experience using a cross-framework control mapping/crosswalk to reduce duplicate implementation effort 

- Comfortable building and reading system/data-flow diagrams, and proficient with a GRC/risk platform (e.g., Drata, Vanta, Hyperproof, Archer, OneTrust, ServiceNow GRC, or similar) 

- Experience translating compliance/risk requirements into implementation guidance engineering teams can act on 

- Comfort engaging directly with both engineering teams and customers on technical topics, and building process/tooling in a growing function 

Nice-to-Have

- Experience with observability for data and ML systems (metrics, logging, drift detection, alerting) and participating in on-call.

- Participating in a 24/7/365 on-call rotation for Incident Management, shared between global service teams.

- Supporting the declaration of incidents or outages, managing incident channels, and identifying triage teams.

- Mitigating business risk by rapidly restoring services, ensuring workarounds are documented, and conducting post-incident reviews (PIRs).

- Leading investigation activities for major incidents and defining problem tasks to reduce the risk of recurrence.

- Proactively identifying recurring issues and emerging trends, and initiating the Problem Management process to enable quicker diagnosis, resolution, and prevention of future incidents.

- Defining, documenting, and refining core service management processes and SOPs based on ITIL/ITSM principles.

- Investigating root causes, analyzing data trends, and managing performance dashboards.

- Acting as a key communication bridge between technical engineering teams, customer success, leadership, and customers with clear, concise internal and customer-facing communications that manage expectations and support SLA commitments.

- Experience: Proven commercial experience in Major Incident Management, Problem Management, and Relationship Management, or similar, plus practical experience working with ITIL principles and ITSM frameworks.

- ITSM Expertise: Solid understanding of ITSM with the ability to resolve diverse issues creatively, apply good judgment, and investigate problems holistically with a “be curious” mentality.

- Communication & Collaboration: Strong interpersonal and effective communication skills, a customer-centric approach, and the confidence to collaborate and influence cross-functionally in a globally and culturally diverse environment.
