Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
Sr. Applications Developer

[Anaplan Model Builder]

At Anaplan, we are innovators dedicated to enhancing business decision-making with our AI-powered scenario planning and analysis platform, enabling our customers to stay ahead of their competition. Our shared commitment to customer success and our Winning Culture unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies.

Our customers include Fortune 50 leaders like Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH, and Bayer, among over 2,400 global companies that trust our best-in-class platform.

The Opportunity

Join Anaplan's Supply Chain Center of Excellence (CoE) as a Sr. Applications Developer and help build next-generation planning applications powering global Supply Chain operations.

In this hands-on Individual Contributor role, you will design, develop, enhance, and support enterprise-scale Anaplan models across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, S&OP, Capacity Planning, Production Planning, and Logistics. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver scalable, high-performing planning solutions leveraging the latest Anaplan capabilities, including Polaris, Workflow, and AI.

Key Responsibilities

Model Development

- Design, build, and maintain scalable Anaplan models supporting end-to-end Supply Chain planning processes.

- Develop modules, lists, line items, actions, imports, exports, processes, dashboards, UX pages, and reports following Anaplan best practices.

- Build reusable model components with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Solution Delivery

- Translate business requirements into robust Anaplan solutions through close collaboration with Product Managers, Solution Architects, and Supply Chain SMEs.

- Participate in solution design sessions, model reviews, testing, and production deployments.

Platform Optimization

- Optimize model performance, sparsity, calculation efficiency, and workspace utilization.

- Apply PLANS methodology and Anaplan modeling best practices to ensure enterprise-grade applications.

Integration & Automation

- Support integrations with enterprise systems using CloudWorks, APIs, Informatica, MuleSoft, or other integration platforms.

- Configure data imports, exports, automated processes, and Workflow capabilities.

Continuous Improvement

- Enhance existing applications using Polaris, Workflow, AI capabilities, and new platform features.

- Troubleshoot production issues and implement sustainable improvements.

Collaboration

- Led closely Engineering, Product Management, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams, extensive team management/working with cross functional stakeholders.

- Contribute technical documentation, implementation assets, and reusable model-building standards.

Success Measures

- Delivery of high-quality, scalable Anaplan models.

- Model performance, maintainability, and usability.

- Successful delivery of application enhancements and releases.

- Adoption of engineering standards and modeling best practices.

- Customer and stakeholder satisfaction.

Qualifications

Experience

- 8–12 years of enterprise application development experience.

- 5+ years of hands-on Anaplan model building and application development.

- Experience delivering enterprise Supply Chain planning solutions.

Technical Skills

- Certified Anaplan Solution Architect (Master Anaplanner certification is a plus).

- Strong expertise in:

- Multi-dimensional model design

- Data Hub architecture

- ALM (Application Lifecycle Management)

- UX Page Builder

- Workflow

- Polaris

- CloudWorks

- Model optimization and performance tuning

- Data integrations and APIs

Supply Chain Domain Expertise ( Preferred )

Hands-on experience implementing one or more of the following:

- Demand Planning

- Supply Planning

- Inventory Planning & Optimization

- Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP / IBP)

- Production Planning

- Capacity Planning

- Procurement Planning

- Distribution & Logistics Planning

Soft Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.

- Ability to work independently in Agile, cross-functional product teams.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) 

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

- Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   

- Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Are you looking for a high-impact opportunity where your expertise will be immediately valued? We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Customer Success Business Partner to join our team.

In this highly visible and vital role, you won't just be keeping the seat warm—you will be a driving force within our Customer Success team. You will step into an established portfolio of key accounts, taking primary responsibility for the successful deployment, user adoption, ongoing health, renewal and upselling/cross-selling motion of their Anaplan solutions.
As the strategic anchor for our customers, you will collaborate closely with Partners, Professional Services, and Account Executives to ensure seamless implementations, exceptional ROI, and long-term success.

If you are a seasoned CS professional who loves parachuting into dynamic environments, delivering immediate value, and shaping customer transformation, this is the perfect opportunity to make your mark.

Your Impact

- Drive Immediate Value: Manage a prominent portfolio of customers, hitting the ground running to drive adoption, expansion, retention, and maximum ROI.

- Be a Strategic Advisor: Guide customers through the value delivery lifecycle, helping them transform their processes and achieve critical business objectives using Anaplan.

- Strategic Leadership: Lead executive-level Quarterly Success Reviews (QSRs), presenting Success Scorecards to executive sponsors and key stakeholders.

- Uncover Value Opportunities: Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment

- Champion the Customer: Proactively build strong relationships, acting as the internal voice of the customer to raise risks, advocate for their needs, and ensure goal alignment.

- Mitigate Risk: Identify renewal risks early and partner seamlessly with Renewal Managers and Account Executives on robust mitigation plans.

- Empower Longevity: Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximise value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Centre of Excellence development, and organizational enablement

- Think Out of The Box: Contribute to our evolving customer success assets, playbooks, and reference case studies, leaving the team stronger than you found it.

 Your Qualifications

- Previous experience driving value in customer success, presales, or management consulting roles.

- Required background in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Planning, or Analytics.

- Exceptional communication and presentation skills; comfortable and confident engaging at all levels, including the C-suite.

- Proven track record in Customer Success, SaaS platforms, Project Leadership, Technology Consulting, or Advisory roles.

- A unique ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, customer-friendly business value.

- Familiarity with software development processes and design methodologies.

- A customer-first mindset coupled with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure.

- Experience leading cross-functional teams to address sophisticated customer needs or deliver key projects.

 Preferred Skills

- Exposure to Financial Services and/or Insurance customers

- Subject matter expertise in Planning and Modelling, particularly in Supply Chain, Finance, or Sales.

- Hands-on experience advising on or establishing a Centre of Excellence (CoE) or similar governance structure.

- Familiarity with Anaplan or comparable enterprise planning platforms.

- Background in change management and enterprise-wide business transformation initiatives.

- Experience crafting customer-facing collateral, such as success playbooks or templates.

- Exposure to renewal strategy and expanding customer footprints through upsell/cross-sell practices.

We know that perfect candidates don't exist. If you are passionate about the work, have the right mindset, and bring a transferable set of skills, we’d love to hear from you - please submit your application.

- Partner with Anaplan’s Product Management, Professional Services, and GTM Enablement Teams to ensure seamless integration of Supply Chain / Retail Applications into Anaplan’s GTM and delivery motion by:

- Serving as the subject matter the Applications, guiding effective implementation strategies.

- Developing and overseeing functional enablement programs, including training, guides, comprehensive documentation for internal and partner use. Drive ecosystem enablement by developing scalable knowledge-sharing initiatives.

- Uphold and enhance implementation standards to maintain Anaplan’s brand integrity.

- Empower partners through training, advisory and supporting services, scaling Anaplan's service delivery capacity and driving implementation success, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.

- Act as a trusted advisor to customers and partners, including presenting Anaplan’s Supply Chain / Retail Applications vision, and demonstrate the solutions at key internal and external events.

- Drive the enablement of Professional Services and Partner Teams to increase and maintain their understanding of the applications, their functionality and implementation implications.

- Ensure the successful implementation of the applications, by providing guidance and advice to the implementation teams.

Your Qualifications

- Deep expertise in supply chain / Retail planning processes, and experience in implementing systems to support these processes. Broad experience across all aspects of end-to-end supply chain is necessary (demand, inventory, production, procurement etc.).

- Excellent communication, facilitation, and knowledge-sharing skills, with a demonstrated ability in presenting compelling content, performing product demonstrations, leading workshops, and developing enablement programs.

- Solid understanding of Anaplan’s platform and how it can be applied to address complex business challenges. This position does not require deep technical or architectural expertise in Anaplan.

- Partner Enablement Plan and Execution: Lead the planning and execution of a comprehensive partner enablement and readiness strategy that aligns with Anaplan’s growth objectives and partner needs. This strategy includes the entire SIs, ISVs, and Cloud partner ecosystem, enabling them on Sales, Pre-Sales and Delivery.

- Partner-led Delivery Excellence Execution: Lead and improve the partner delivery excellence program to ensure high-quality partner-led implementations and best practices, helping Anaplan customers get the most value from Anaplan Apps and Platform.

- Joint Operating Model: Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Apps CoEs, PS, CS, Lauch and other internal teams to define and execute a joint operating model that lead to accelerated GTM outcomes. Design innovative delivery mechanisms in collaboration with PS to ensure effective knowledge transfer and skill development.

- Participate in Product Launch Process to evaluate and advise on Partner Enablement, early access launch partner and beta programs

- Outcome Based Enablement: Develop and track key performance indicators to measure the impact of enablement programs, assess partner readiness, and identify opportunities for continuous optimization.

- Establish and host Partner Days, partner workshops, enablement events, within your region to ensure Partners build up the relevant contacts within Customer Success, Product, Sales and Support.

- You’ll interact with senior leadership internally and externally and play an important role in overall partner advocacy. 

Your qualifications, your influence 

- 15+ years of experience in high growth SaaS companies, focused on enabling partners across go-to-market, application/solution development and delivery.

- Technical knowledge of SaaS applications, cloud platforms, data management is a must either as a pre-sales consultant, partner architect or implementation architect.

- EPM deployment/pre-sales experience or Anaplan product experience is preferable.

- Expert software pre-sales, training, enablement, facilitation and technical workshop delivery skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

- A proven track record of planning and executing partner enablement plans in a high growth, mid stage Enterprise SaaS company to develop a ready partner ecosystem.

- Experience in managing implementation projects, mitigating projects risks and co-ordinating with internal stakeholders to help partners deliver customer value.

- Deep understanding of SaaS and Enterprise Sales business model with an understanding of partner & customer lifecycle measures and SaaS revenue streams.

- Data-driven with a dedication to process improvement.

- Strong reputation working with cross functional teams as being innovative, accountable, reliable, and able to thrive in a constantly changing environment

- Prior experience in a sales-driven organization working with large GSI’s, technology partners and delivering to Fortune 500 clients; Prior experience scaling a consulting and tech partner program, with clear increase in revenue and retention is a plus

- History of motivating partners at scale, while identifying and developing the right partners for strategic relationships.

- Expert in driving solution discussions with partners on data, AI and ML with expertise in predictive, generative and agentic AI technologies.

postings.description:

Anaplan is seeking an accomplished, highly strategic Sr. Strategic Alliances Director, GSI, scale, and accelerate our strategic Global System Integrator (GSI) and System Integrator (SI) ecosystem in North America. This senior leader will hold direct portfolio ownership for premier SI/GSI partnerships, driving the creation and execution of differentiated go-to-market (GTM) motions that deliver significant partner-originated and co-sold Annual Contract Value (ACV) and pipeline.

In this high-visibility leadership role, you will collaborate extensively across internal and external stakeholders, including GTM leadership, Industry Partner Sales Directors, Product management, Customer Success, and partner executive teams. You will drive strategic growth across all of Anaplan’s functional domains (Finance, Supply Chain, Sales Performance Management, and Human Resources), implementing joint programs that elevate customer lifetime value, expand services revenue, and ensure institutional partner delivery readiness.

Your Impact

- As a catalyst for enterprise growth, the Senior Director, GSI Alliances directly influences Anaplan’s market valuation and customer success through four primary impact pillars:

- Drives Exponential Revenue Growth: Maximizes SaaS revenue and expands market share through the SI partner ecosystem, consistently exceeding sourced and co-sold ACV and pipeline targets.

- Expands Market Reach & GTM Effectiveness: Scales Anaplan’s enterprise presence across North America by commercializing differentiated, partner-led industry solution plays and co-innovation initiatives.

- Strengthens Partner Delivery Capability & Readiness: Builds institutional consulting capacity, technical enablement, and delivery excellence across partner practices, ensuring rapid time-to-value and implementation quality.

- Elevates Customer Lifetime Value & Account Expansion: Enhances enterprise customer satisfaction, post-sale adoption, and account expansion through comprehensive, partner-delivered transformation solutions across multiple business domains.

Key Responsibilities & Core Accountabilities 

Strategic Business Planning & Alliance Governance

- Multi-Year Business Plans: Architect, negotiate, and execute comprehensive multi-year partner business plans with assigned SI/GSI partners, establishing clear joint revenue targets, strategic solution offerings, joint investments, talent & ecosystem development goals, marketing programs, and priority target accounts.

- Stakeholder Governance & Mapping: Lead overall stakeholder governance, executive relationship mapping, and collaboration cadences across partner executive leadership, Anaplan executive teams, Partner Success, Partner Marketing, and Field Sales.

- Alliance Oversight & Performance Reviews: Provide strategic oversight of the alliance portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), approving regional GTM strategies, managing risk escalations, and ensuring alignment with joint commitments.

Sourced & Co-Sell Pipeline and Revenue Execution

- Revenue Generation & Quota Attainment: Own, drive, and exceed aggressive annual sourced and co-sold ACV and originated pipeline targets through active engagement with assigned SI partnerships.

- Sales Cycle Collaboration & Alignment: Partner intimately with Industry Partner Sales Directors and sector sales leaders on partner-driven opportunities, providing deal alignment, commercial strategy, and active coaching throughout the entire sales cycle from initiation to closure.

- Target Account Expansion: Drive expansion of both software ACV and consulting/services revenue across targeted enterprise accounts through focused joint account planning, executive alignment, and co-investment.

Go-to-Market Plays & Solution Commercialization

- GTM & Product Collaboration: Function as an active, extended member of Anaplan’s GTM and Product organizations to co-develop differentiated, high-value solution offerings, packaged applications, and joint plays.

- Multi-Domain Market Activation: Drive market activation of current and future solutions across key functional domains (Finance, Supply Chain, Sales Performance Management, and HR) within target industry sectors.

- Marketing & Thought Leadership Activation: Own all communication and enablement across Anaplan and assigned partners to activate field teams on strategic GTM plays, joint marketing campaigns, reference architectures, and customer case studies.

Operational Rigor, Performance Management & Hygiene

- Weekly Telemetry & Performance Tracking: Leverage enterprise data, CRM dashboards, and reporting tools weekly to monitor partner performance, track pipeline progression, identify emerging growth opportunities, and execute corrective action plans.

- Reporting & Forecasting Hygiene: Maintain meticulous reporting hygiene, transparent tracking of KPIs, accurate ACV forecasting, and comprehensive visibility into alliance health and governance.

Performance Expectations & Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The success of the Senior Director, GSI Alliances is evaluated against clear, quantifiable business metrics and governance standards:

- Sourced & Co-Sell Revenue Quota Attainment: Consistently achieve or exceed assigned sourced and co-sold Annual Contract Value (ACV) targets and partner-originated pipeline goals.

- Pipeline Velocity & Deal Progression: Accelerate partner-influenced pipeline expansion, win rates, and sales cycle velocity through proactive co-sell engagement and deal alignment.

- Governance, Operational Accuracy & Hygiene: Maintain rigorous partner governance, reporting accuracy, weekly performance tracking, and high-fidelity pipeline forecasting.

- Practice Capability & Ecosystem Expansion: Successfully expand certified partner consulting headcount, accredited delivery capacity, and referencable joint customer deployments across target domains.

Your Qualifications, Your Influence

As a Threat Response Engineer, you will lead and improve how we investigate, respond to, and learn from security incidents. This is a senior, hands-on role that combines deep digital forensics and incident response expertise with strong threat intelligence knowledge. You will lead complex investigations, perform forensic analysis, conduct threat hunting, and leverage intelligence to understand who we are up against and how they operate.

You'll help build a mature, intelligence-driven IR capability, focused on the adversaries who target organisations like ours, including state-sponsored actors, well-resourced criminal groups, and attackers making growing use of AI.

What you'll be doing

- Act as technical lead on our security incidents, owning the investigation end-to-end, from triage and scoping through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review

- Act as the escalation point for the SOC on confirmed and complex incidents, directing SOC analysts on containment and monitoring during live response

- Perform digital forensic analysis across endpoints, servers, cloud, SaaS, and identity environments, preserving evidence and reconstructing attacker activity and timelines

- Use what you find to understand adversary tradecraft, likely objectives, and related activity, and use that understanding to guide scoping and response decisions

- Work alongside IT, Engineering, Identity, Service Management, legal, privacy, and communications teams during major incidents, and with external incident response partners where needed

- Rapidly assess emerging threats, zero-days and actively exploited vulnerabilities for real-world exposure across our environment, and drive preemptive response where needed

- Lead proactive, hypothesis-led threat hunts informed by investigation findings, intelligence, and emerging tradecraft, and work with the SOC to turn the results into tested, high-fidelity detections

- Produce internal threat reporting that translates what we're seeing in our environment, and across the threat landscape relevant to us, into clear assessments and actions for security teams and leadership

- Contribute to our threat intelligence capability, including intelligence requirements and the sources and tooling that support them, keeping it directly connected to investigation, hunting, and detection work

- Expand incident response playbooks, forensic procedures, and evidence handling standards, raise the standard of how we run complex investigations, and coach SOC analysts through live investigations

- Design and run tabletop exercises for technical and executive audiences

- Track post-incident remediation actions through to closure

- Use AI as a core part of how you work, building and applying AI-assisted workflows and automation for evidence collection, enrichment, triage, and analysis, and integrating them with our security tooling

- Take part in an on-call rota for high-severity incidents

Key Responsibilities

- Extensive hands-on experience in digital forensics and incident response, including leading complex, high-severity investigations across hybrid, cloud, and SaaS environments

- Practical forensic skills across endpoint, memory, network, log, and cloud evidence, with a sound approach to evidence handling and chain of custody

- An intelligence mindset developed through investigative work: you naturally ask who is behind activity, what they want, and what else they're likely to have done, and you can turn investigation findings into intelligence that drives hunting, detection, and reporting

- Working knowledge of intelligence analysis fundamentals, such as intelligence requirements, structured analysis and confidence assessments, and how they apply to incident response

- Experience leading hypothesis-driven threat hunting and converting findings into detections

- Demonstrable, hands-on experience using AI in security work, such as building AI-assisted investigation or triage workflows, using LLMs to accelerate analysis, or developing automation and integrations, with a grounded view of where it helps and where it doesn't. Solid scripting ability (e.g. Python) to support this

- Good knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, and EDR/XDR platforms and how they support investigation, hunting, and response

- Strong understanding of attacker behaviour and the MITRE ATT&CK framework, particularly across enterprise, cloud, and SaaS environments

- Ability to explain complex technical findings clearly and concisely, in writing and in person, to executive audiences, including CISO-level stakeholders

- Calm, structured judgement during high-pressure incidents, with a drive to share knowledge and raise the capability of the wider team

Desirable

- Familiarity with the cybercrime underground, including how criminal forums and marketplaces, initial access brokers, and ransomware ecosystems operate, and experience safely operating and managing research personas

- Familiarity with intelligence models such as the Diamond Model and F3EAD

- Relevant certifications such as GCFA, GCIH or GCTI

- Experience designing or running tabletop exercises or crisis management

Insight on Your Impact

This role serves as the strategic leader for Anaplan's global technology and product ecosystem. You will be responsible for defining and executing our global technology partnership strategy, building innovative alliances with Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), Data Cloud/AI platforms, and Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), while scaling our Partner Apps program. You will translate complex technical integrations into high-impact, revenue-generating go-to-market motions executed in collaboration with regional partner sales teams.

Your focus will be centered on developing strategic Technology, Data/AI, and Cloud partnerships, alongside leading and expanding the Partner Apps program to drive platform extensibility and customer value. In parallel, you will curate high-leverage "Power of Three" motions—aligning Anaplan, technology partners, and System Integrators (SIs) to deliver comprehensive, differentiated enterprise solutions. You will own this function end-to-end: from initial strategy development and team build-out to hands-on partner development, solution co-innovation, and global scaling.

Strategy & Technology Partnership Development

- Ecosystem Vision: Define, build, and execute the strategic roadmap for next-generation technology partnerships, including Cloud Service Providers (CSPs such as AWS, GCP, Azure), Data Cloud/AI platforms (such as Snowflake, Databricks), and strategic enterprise ISVs.

- Tip of the Spear Execution: Identify emerging technological trends—particularly in Data Cloud, AI, and enterprise planning architectures—to design, incubate, and pilot joint technology partner initiatives. Ensure the organization adapts quickly to market shifts and customer requirements.

- Partner Apps Program Leadership: Lead the end-to-end strategy, governance, technical enablement, and commercial execution of Anaplan’s Partner Apps program to accelerate platform extensibility, marketplace growth, and new recurring revenue streams.

- Joint Solution Innovation: Partner with technology partners' product and engineering teams to identify high-value integration use cases, co-create architectural blueprints, and bring differentiated joint solutions to market.

GTM Translation & Cross-Functional Alignment

- GTM Integration & Scalability: Translate technical integrations and strategic alliance agreements into structured, repeatable GTM plays that can be adopted and executed by regional partner sales and direct sales teams.

- "Power of 3" Orchestration: Curate and champion high-impact "Power of 3" motions, aligning Anaplan, Cloud/Data technology partners, and Global Systems Integrators (GSIs/SIs) to deliver complete, market-leading industry solutions.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, Alliances, and Regional Theater Leaders (AMER, EMEA, APAC) to ensure seamless technical roadmap alignment and commercial throughput of technology partnership plays.

Team Building & Performance Leadership

- Global Team Build-Out: Take full accountability for designing the organizational structure, hiring, and mentoring a world-class team of technology partner directors, alliance managers, and partner app specialists.

- Accountability & Execution: Move seamlessly between high-level strategic alliance design and hands-on operational execution. Foster a high-performance culture that manages partner milestones strictly to plan and continuously measures partner-sourced and partner-influenced impact.

- Ecosystem Evangelism: Serve as a prominent executive sponsor and thought leader for Anaplan’s technology alliances and Partner Apps ecosystem, representing Anaplan at industry conferences, partner summits, and executive advisory boards.

The ideal candidate is an agile, strategic executive with deep credibility across the enterprise software ecosystem and strong technical acumen. - Tech Ecosystem Leadership: Deep, verifiable experience identifying, structuring, and expanding strategic partnerships with ISVs, Data Cloud/AI platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks), and major Cloud Service Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).

- Partner Apps & Platform Extensibility: Proven success establishing, scaling, or commercializing a Partner Apps program, ISV marketplace, or platform extension ecosystem.

- Incubation to Revenue: Demonstrated track record of converting technical product integrations into active, revenue-generating GTM motions that deliver measurable ACV.

- Executive Presence & Influence: Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship-building capabilities, with demonstrated success influencing C-suite executives and product leaders both internally and externally.

- Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS architectures, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud platform topologies to credibly lead joint solution development with product and engineering counterparts.

- Team Building & People Leadership: Extensive experience building, leading, and mentoring high-performing global alliance teams, with clear accountability for execution and pipeline results.

- SI & "Power of Three" Collaboration: Strong familiarity with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and proven experience curating tripartite ("Power of 3") motions combining technology partners, SIs, and software platforms to win large enterprise transformations.

- Hyper-Growth SaaS Track Record: 10+ years of progressive leadership in technology alliances, strategic business development, or partner ecosystems within high-growth enterprise software companies.

- 製造業の大手戦略アカウントに対する業務課題の特定と、Anaplanのソリューション提案

- Cレベルのステークホルダーへの営業経験と実績 

- 年間契約価値（ACV）1億円以上の大型契約を複数成功させた実績

- 複雑な社内外チームを調整・推進した経験 

- 製造業における部門長〜Cレベルとの接点・人脈 

- 製造業に対する深い理解と営業経験

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

- Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   

- Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.
